prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down at the object's TOP SURFACE ONLY. Show no vertical front or side faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game building sprite for the D'thorga field bin: a round steel grain bin that stands at the edge of a paddock and holds a harvest until it is carted away, in a hard-scrabble frontier colony. Image 1 is our approved chaser bin from the same farm: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only.

Square canvas, plain pure white background. The bin is a perfect circle seen from straight above, centred, filling about nine tenths of the canvas.

Its roof plan: a shallow cone of corrugated galvanised steel, its ridges running from the rim to the centre like the spokes of a wheel; a small round filling hatch with a lid at the very centre; a narrow ladder and a short safety rail running from the rim up to the hatch on one side; four short steel legs just visible beyond the rim at the corners; one small harvest-green band round the rim and a muted yellow cap on the hatch.

Style: a top-down sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No grain, no ground, no people, no animals, no vehicles, no dust, mud or damage, no text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, screens or lamps. No floor, field, shadow outside the object, perspective, tilt or visible side faces. Top surfaces only.
